data.title: 早露 · 书店的包装纸
data.description: 店员借给她一卷丝带。早露将准备送人的书包好，觉得蝴蝶结有些歪，又解开重新系了一次。
data.promptProse: In the quietest corner of an old bookshop, Rosa carefully ties a delicate blue ribbon around a thick, antique hardbound book. Towering dark wooden bookshelves loaded with leather-bound classics fill the background, while the soft, amber glow of vintage reading lamps creates a serene, scholarly sanctuary for her peaceful activity.
data.animaCaption: Standing in a quiet corner of the old bookshop, she neatly ties a slender blue ribbon around a thick antique hardcover held gently in her hands. Soft amber light from vintage reading lamps warms the towering wooden shelves.
